paragraphs.text:
After walking several miles, the hunters make camp. Some of 
them go off into the woods with their rifles, probably to shoot 
something for supper. The others rest around the fire.

You have successfully tracked them, but your next step 
is unclear.
To approach the hunters, go to 588. To give this up, go to 513.
